principles: use three substantive lessons per unit with lesson-3 independent production or mediation
recycle B1 narration, realistic conditions, reported information, reasons and practical negotiation across new everyday domains
require short coherent output rather than isolated sentence recognition
avoid B2 counterfactuals, dense concession, inferential evidential calibration, multi-source synthesis and sustained abstract argumentation
keep Persian support concise, natural and task-oriented

units.title: Değişikliği anlatıp tavsiyeyi aktarmak
units.objective: Describe how a common health problem has changed, relay simple professional advice and explain a realistic follow-up plan.
units.grammar_focus: change over time, reported advice and realistic conditions
utterances: Baş ağrım azaldı ama halsizliğim devam ediyor.

Use simple past/present to show change, -memi/-mamı tavsiye etti or -mem gerektiğini söyledi to relay advice, and -sa/-se only for realistic follow-up conditions.

production.writing_prompt_fa: در ۴ تا ۵ جمله وضعیت یک مشکل معمول سلامت را توضیح بده: چه زمانی شروع شد، چه تغییری کرده، چه توصیه‌ای گرفتی و اگر ادامه پیدا کند چه می‌کنی.

units.title: Mahalledeki değişimi anlatıp öneri sunmak

Contrast past and present with eskiden/artık or past/present forms, support a personal view with çünkü or a concrete example, and finish with one practical proposal.
